analysis_md:
设质心坐标为 $(\bar{x},\bar{y},\bar{z})$，由立体结构知 $\bar{x}=\bar{y}=\bar{z}$，
而
$$
\bar{z}=\frac{\rho_0\cdot\iiint_\Omega z\,dv}{\rho_0\cdot\iiint_\Omega1\,dv}
=\frac{\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\varphi\int_0^1r^3\sin\varphi\cos\varphi\,dr}{\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\varphi\int_0^1r^2\sin\varphi\,dr}
=\frac{3}{8}.
$$
